title: Aztec launches v5 alpha to improve privacy transactions on Ethereum
summary: Ethereum layer-two project Aztec (AZTEC) has launched its v5 alpha, enabling fully private transactions to be processed directly on users’ devices, The Block reported. The update was applied on-chain after governance approval from token holders, making end-to-end private transaction processing possible on smartphones and standard laptops.Average transaction costs fell around 50%, while block times shortened to six seconds from 14 seconds. Rollup proof verification costs also dropped about 40%, lowering average fees for private token transactions to under $0.05. Co-founder Zac Williamson said the system was designed to provide a privacy-preserving layer first for Ethereum (ETH) and, over the long term, for cryptocurrencies more broadly.

title: India's Maharashtra state pushes first bill on tokenized real estate trading
summary: India's Maharashtra state is pushing to enact the Digitalization and Exchange of Land Token Assets Act, or DELTA Act, a bill that would allow real estate to be traded as blockchain-based tokens. The legislative push would be the first of its kind by an Indian state government.Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said on X he chaired a meeting on the draft bill and instructed relevant authorities to prepare legislation so value embedded in real estate can be used for the public interest and as a new source of tax revenue. The plan links token prices to underlying real estate values and processes related transactions and operational procedures through a blockchain-based digital system.The state government plans to form an expert committee including officials from the Securities and Exchange Board of India, or SEBI, and local stock exchanges, and to review overseas legal and regulatory cases.
